UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account profile and cloud synchronization consent settings.

id.description: The user UID matching the authenticated user.

cloudSyncConsent.description: Whether user explicitly consented to cloud synchronization.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: A private reflection or journal entry belonging to the user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry.

userId.description: UID of the owner of the reflection.

title.description: Title or short preview of the reflection.

rawText.description: The journal text content or encrypted payload.

hasReflection.description: Whether an untangled reflection analysis is attached.

reflectionData.description: Serialized or encrypted JSON of the reflection result.

isEncrypted.description: Whether the entry was encrypted client-side.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when entry was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when entry was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile with explicit cloud storage consent.

/users/{userId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Private journal reflections owned strictly by the authenticated user.
